systems.platform: Mobile application, Android only at launch; co-developed by LMPS, UNDP, the National University of Lesotho and Econet Telecom Lesotho; zero-rated by Econet
systems.tiers: Communities and Crime Prevention Committees report crime and violence to the police; launched nationally by 20 April 2026

systems.owner: Lesotho Mounted Police Service, supported by the UN Peacebuilding Fund through UNDP, OHCHR and UN Women
systems.tiers: Police stations, to be equipped so officers can monitor reported cases; no count given

note: UNDP news of 20 April 2026. Lehokela is described as a mobile app through which communities and Crime Prevention Committees report crime to the police, so it is class public and gives no fact; the ICT initiative is enabling. The document also names a five-year LMPS Strategic Plan, a Digital Transformation Policy and a Digital Transformation Strategy, drafted with UNDP technical support and funded by the Peacebuilding Fund, and says the launch lays a foundation for a centralised digital system for tracking crime; it describes no system in which stations record reports or cases.
